heading: **2 January 2026**
body:
*1\. Set up cultures for protein production*  
*2\. Repeat transformation*

Each vial of the Rosetta cells is 0.2 mL ⇒ Aliquot into 20 uL each and transform by adding 0.3 uL of each plasmid.

Each plasmid is resuspended in 100 uL of NF water i.e. concentration \= \~40 ng/uL

DBP147  
DBP152  
DPRX\_DBD  
DBP142  
DBP154  
DBP155  
dmGAGA\_DBD

*3\. Hia5testlig QC \+ Hia5 treatment*

*HT-SELEX test buffer:* 

PCR 1 → 10X

| **Water** | **90**  |

| 98°C | 3 min |
